2.69.20
Table.PageBreakAtEnd
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The Table.PageBreakAtEnd element specifies that a renderer inserts a page break at the end of this
Table. This element is optional. The value of the Table.PageBreakAtEnd element MUST be a Boolean
([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.2). If this element is not specified, its value is interpreted as false.
Following is the parent element of the Table.PageBreakAtEnd element.
Parent elements
Table
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Table.PageBreakAtEnd element.
 <xsd:element name="PageBreakAtEnd" type="xsd:boolean" minOccurs="0" />
